title: Sunny Corn Pilaf
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make pilaf dish packed with the sweetness of corn and the warmth of Turkish spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced yellow bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the Turkish pilaf rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the yellow corn kernels and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork to separate the grains.
